entities.summary: Albergaria dos Doze is a former civil parish in the municipality of Pombal, Portugal. In 2013, the parish merged into the new parish Santiago e São Simão de Litém e Albergaria dos Doze. The population in 2011 was 1,765, in an area of 22.84 km².
